_comment: F24 budgets, checked by e2e/app/scenarios/F24-fleet-perf.mjs on every CI runner.
Memory is resident memory as the OS reports it (fleet_memory, src-tauri/src/fleet.rs).
idleAppMemoryMb: Hermes with no session open. On Windows and Linux this includes the
web view's processes; on macOS the web view is a system service outside Hermes's
process tree and is not counted.
perSessionAppMemoryMb: what one more open terminal session costs Hermes itself
((Hermes with 20 sessions - idle) / 20), sessions' own processes not counted.
agentSessionMemoryMb: a session running the fake agent (shell + node), as its row shows it.
ptyThroughputMbPerSec: plain text printed in a visible terminal, time until the last line is
on screen: a floor at about half of what CI measured on 2026-09-28 (debug test build):
macOS 1.18-1.66, Linux 1.39-2.02 MB/s. Windows is two-speed: the console host either hands
over ~2 KB pieces (0.74-0.79 MB/s) or one line at a time (~86 bytes, 0.03-0.04 MB/s, seen in
2 of 4 runs, with the same output path as main); its floor only catches a stall.
floodMb: how much text that throughput step prints on each OS (less where the terminal is slow).
echoLatencyMs: Enter pressed to the command's output on screen, over 20 open sessions (p95 and worst).
switchMs: clicking a session row to its terminal being shown, graphics context included (worst).
